thread:
Maya: Quick PSA — after yesterday's kernel-picker tweak, we observed a prefix cache hit-rate drop of ~9% on canary. Short prompts with tool calls are missing more often. Aggregates: hit-rate 0.78 -> 0.71, p99 latency +12ms.
Ryan: Any tokenizer changes in that deploy or just kernel selection?
Maya: No tokenizer bump. The only change was the kernel selector preferring fast-attn-v2 for small batches. Profiling shows different batching alignment and more KV writes. Also noticed diffs in system prompt keying — tool JSON field ordering looks different in missed keys.
Sam: Can you paste a couple of serialized keys (miss vs hit) and the profile snippets? I can run a local cohort with PREFETCH_DEBUG=1.
Maya: Example (hit): `sys|tok:v1|tool_meta:{"name":"search","args":{"q":"x","mode":"short"}}|user:...` (miss): `sys|tok:v1|tool_meta:{"args":{"q":"x","mode":"short"},"name":"search"}|user:...` — ordering changed. Also kernel change altered request batching sequences.
InfraBot: Experiment summary — exp_id 4479: kernel-picker roll to canary. Sampled 1.2M reqs. Prefetch hit 78% -> 70% in cohort. Top covariate: tool_meta key ordering (34% of misses), second: short-seq batching alignment (22%).
Elena: We changed the toolmeta serializer to use insertion-order JSON for perf; previously we canonicalized by sorting keys. That will blow up cache cardinality when callers send same args in diff order.
Ryan: Options: revert kernel picker; restore canonicalization on key path; or tag tok-version to key. What's lowest-risk and fastest?
Tom: I can implement canonicalize_tool_meta in the prefix-keyer (sort keys, normalize numeric formatting, strip insignificant whitespace). Low-risk patch + unit tests -> I'll open PR 4479123465.
Maya: Please also tag the prefix key with `tok_enc:v2` (or current tokenizer hash) so tokenizer rolls don't cause silent miss spikes.
Sam: I'll run a simulation for the canonicalizer using recent traces and measure expected hit recovery. If canonicalization recovers >=4% hit, we avoid reverting kernel picker.
InfraBot: Note: adding tokenizer-version to key increases key cardinality; suggest a targeted warmup/backfill for top 50 routes after change to avoid cold cost spikes.
Elena: Also propose a short-term heuristic in miss path: if a miss-only-diff is ordering of tool args, treat as a 'soft-miss' and enqueue a warmup async instead of full compute.
Ryan: Action items: Tom PR for canonicalize toolmeta + tok-version tag; Sam run sims and post numbers; Maya monitor canary and update dashboard; Infra schedule backfill for top routes. :thumbsup: 
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll add a tiny eval to compare hit delta by route and post results here.
